title: Amlodipine/rosuvastatin, perindopril/amlodipine/rosuvastatin: CMDh scientific conclusions and grounds for variation, amendments to the product information and timetable for the implementation (PSUSA/00010434/202107)
authors: European Medicines Agency, Pharmacovigilance Risk Assessment Committee (PRAC) and Coordination Group for Mutual Recognition and Decentralised Procedures (CMDh)
journal: European Medicines Agency; CMDh position adopted at the March 2022 meeting
funder: not stated; a regulatory assessment carries no funding statement
result: In view of literature data on non-cardiogenic pulmonary oedema, spontaneous reports including cases with a compatible temporal relationship and a plausible mechanism of action, the PRAC considers a causal relationship between amlodipine and non-cardiogenic pulmonary oedema at least a reasonable possibility, and the CMDh agrees. New text for section 4.9 of the summary of product characteristics: gross overdosage could result in excessive peripheral vasodilatation and possibly reflex tachycardia; marked and probably prolonged systemic hypotension up to and including shock with fatal outcome has been reported; non-cardiogenic pulmonary oedema has rarely been reported as a consequence of amlodipine overdose, may manifest with a delayed onset 24 to 48 hours after ingestion and require ventilatory support, and early resuscitative measures, including fluid overload, to maintain perfusion and cardiac output may be precipitating factors. The package leaflet is to state that fluid may accumulate in the lungs up to 24 to 48 hours after an overdose. Translations were transmitted on 8 May 2022 and implementation by member states was set for 7 July 2022.
